excerpts.text: Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.
Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).
Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.
Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.

Name: Heimerdinger. Official role tags: Mage, Support.

H-28G Evolution Turret
COST:
20 Mana + 1 Turret Kit
COOLDOWN:
1
CAST TIME:
0.25
RECHARGE:
20
TARGET RANGE:
350
Active: Heimerdinger deploys a rapid-fire turret that deals magic damage to his target, or a nearby enemy. The turret will become dormant while he leaves it alone. Heimerdinger periodically stocks a Turret Kit, up to a maximum of 3. The turret has a secondary beam attack that charges up over time, which deals magic damage to enemies hit.
Active: Heimerdinger deploys a H-28G Evolution Turret at the target location, which lasts until destroyed.
Heimerdinger periodically stocks a Turret Kit charge, up to a maximum of 3.
Up to 3 H-28G Evolution Turrets can be deployed at a time, with those deployed beyond the maximum destroying the oldest one.
See Pets for more details about H-28G Evolution Turrets.

COOLDOWN:

TARGET RANGE:

UPGRADE: Heimerdinger instead deploys a slow-fire turret that attacks a nearby enemy champion, dealing magic damage and slowing nearby enemies. The turret has a secondary beam attack that charges up over time and while it fires, which deals magic damage to enemies hit.
UPGRADE!!! - Active: Heimerdinger deploys a H-28Q Apex Turret at the target location, which lasts for 8 seconds.
H-28Q Apex Turret scales with UPGRADE!!!'s rank.
See Pets for more details about the H-28Q Apex Turret.

Hextech Micro-Rockets
COST:
50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 Mana
COOLDOWN:
11 / 10 / 9 / 8 / 7
CAST TIME:
0.25
TARGET RANGE:
1150
Active: Heimerdinger fires a wave of rockets that converge to the target location and fan beyond it to max range, each dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit. Enemies take less damage from subsequent rockets that hit them. Whenever a rocket hits an enemy champion, nearby turrets gain some beam charge.
Active: Heimerdinger launches a wave of 5 rockets that converge upon the target location and fan beyond it up to a maximum range, with each one dealing magic damage to the first enemy it hits. Every rocket hitting an enemy champion grants 20% beam charge to all turrets within 1000 range, up to a maximum of 100% beam charge when hitting 5 rockets on an enemy champion.
Initial Rocket Magic Damage:50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 (+ 55% AP)
Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets, but receive less damage from ones beyond the first. Against minions, this lesser damage is increased by 200%.
Subsequent Rocket Magic Damage:10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 (+ 12% AP)Total Subsequent Non-Minion Damage:40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 (+ 48% AP)Combined Total Non-Minion Damage:90 / 135 / 180 / 225 / 270 (+ 103% AP)
Subsequent Rocket Minion Damage:30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 (+ 36% AP)Total Subsequent Minion Damage:120 / 180 / 240 / 300 / 360 (+ 144% AP)Combined Total Minion Damage:170 / 255 / 340 / 425 / 510 (+ 199% AP)

COOLDOWN:
11 / 10 / 9 / 8 / 7
CAST TIME:
0.25

UPGRADE: Heimerdinger now fires 4 waves of rockets, each rocket dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit. Enemies take less damage from subsequent rockets that hit them.
UPGRADE!!! - Active: Heimerdinger unleashes 4 waves of 5 rockets in quick succession that converge upon the target location. Each rocket deals magic damage to the first enemy hit.
Hextech Rocket Swarm scales with UPGRADE!!!'s rank

Active: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade to the target location that deals magic damage and slows nearby enemies. Enemies hit at the epicenter are also stunned. If the grenade hits an enemy champion, nearby turrets gain full beam charge.
Active: Heimerdinger hurls a grenade at the target location that detonates upon impact, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. If the grenade hits an enemy champion, all turrets within 1000 range of the impact gain 100% beam charge.

UPGRADE!!!
COST:
100 Mana
COOLDOWN:
100 / 85 / 70
CAST TIME:
none
STATIC COOLDOWN:
3
Active: Heimerdinger can empower his next ability to apply an additional effect. These empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not cost mana. UPGRADE!!! can be recast after a short time, and does so automatically upon casting another ability. Recast: UPGRADE!!! ends and is put on a short cooldown.
Toggle: Heimerdinger empowers his next basic ability for an additional effect, consuming the empowerment upon cast and placing UPGRADE!!! on full cooldown. These empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not have a mana cost.
UPGRADE!!! incurs its static cooldown on-cast, and can be toggled off to remove the empowerment and place the ability on its static cooldown.
UPGRADE!!! can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
Notes/General Details
Targeting input
Auto
Affects
Self
NOTICE TO API USERS:Damage classifications are being amended across the League of Legends Wiki and also being refactored into the "Damage Info" tab.
Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Consuming the buff for an empowered basic ability does.
No compensations for mana are made if UPGRADE!!! is toggled off; Heimerdinger will lose 100 mana each time he toggles the ability on and off.
